title: Specialist Psychiatrist – Northern Norway
description:
Specialist Psychiatrist – Northern Norway

 

We are looking for a specialist psychiatrist for a permanent position in Northern Norway.

You will join a well-functioning outpatient clinic and work closely with an experienced team. The region is known for its relaxed pace of life, strong professional environments, and supportive colleagues.

Your role
  • Assess, diagnose, and treat patients with psychiatric conditions
  • Contribute actively to interdisciplinary collaboration and treatment planning
  • Supervise junior doctors and support internal training
  • Take part in developing the service and improving clinical practice
Qualifications
  • European medical authorization and specialist certification in psychiatry
  • Good English skills and motivation to learn Norwegian (language training provided)
  • Solid clinical competence and ability to work independently
What the clinic offers
  • Permanent position in a stable and well-organized outpatient unit
  • Close collaboration with experienced and supportive colleagues
  • Flexible working hours, with options for extended shifts and additional pay
  • Access to courses, seminars, and continuous professional development
  • Optional participation in acute care rotation, with extra compensation
  • Pension and insurance schemes through KLP
Why Northern Norway?

title: Researcher Position in AI Native Networking for Healthcare
description:
The Section for Medical Information and Communication Technology (Medical ICT Research), The Intervention Centre, Oslo University Hospital, offers a full-time, two-year Researcher position in the Wireless Sensor Network Research Group of Professor Ilangko Balasingham.

We seek candidates with a solid background in computer networking who want to develop machine-learning methods for network control and network-aware distributed learning.

The research group has a strong scientific and technical background in wireless communications, machine learning and artificial intelligence, as well as radio frequency engineering and electronics. It collaborates closely with physician-scientists at the Intervention Centre. The Centre is internationally recognized for its scientific excellence and unique position in the field, promoting interdisciplinary research and development. You will work in a diverse and intellectually stimulating environment that fosters creativity, innovation, and scientific excellence in the development of future ICT-based healthcare solutions.

Oslo University Hospital is a workplace with great diversity. We believe this is crucial for solving our tasks in the best possible way. We want this diversity to be reflected among the applicants for our positions, and we encourage all qualified candidates, regardless of background, to apply! Work Tasks

SYNAPSE, funded by the Research Council of Norway, develops networks that adapt their decisions to network conditions and the clinical urgency of the information they carry. Learning is integrated into network control to support decisions about scheduling, routing and resource allocation. For example, an urgent clinical alert should reach its destination promptly even when links are congested and patients are moving.

The project also develops distributed and federated learning methods that adapt to connectivity, available resources and clinical priorities. Network control and distributed learning are designed together, so that the network supports learning and learning remains effective when communication is constrained. The methods are evaluated in remote patient monitoring and hospital-at-home scenarios.

This position focuses on network protocols and their control at the MAC, network, transport and cross-layer levels, combined with machine learning. It does not cover hardware, antennas, circuits or physical-layer signal processing, and is not a general data-science position. Applicants must document relevant computer-networking knowledge and experience.

Research areas

  • Learning-based network control, including scheduling, link selection, routing and resource allocation in wireless and edge networks.
  • Reinforcement learning and multi-agent reinforcement learning for distributed network decision-making.
  • Graph and hypergraph representation learning of network state, including temporal graph neural networks.
  • Network- and urgency-aware distributed and federated learning, adapting the exchange of data and model updates to network conditions and clinical priorities.
  • Evaluation through network simulation and emulation, and with real remote patient monitoring data.

Responsibilities

  • Lead research on learning-based, urgency-aware network control and distributed learning that adapts to network state and clinical priority.
  • Collaborate with the PhD fellow and master’s students.
  • Publish in leading networking venues and contribute to project management and new proposals.
Kvalifikasjoner (overskrift)

Required Qualifications

  • A PhD in computer networking, communications or computer science with a clear networking focus.
  • Publications on networking topics and demonstrated experience developing or applying machine-learning methods to networking problems.
  • Experience with network simulation, emulation or testbeds.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with multi-agent reinforcement learning, graph learning or federated learning.
  • Experience supervising students or contributing to research proposals.

Language Requirements

  • Very good written and spoken English.

Personal Qualities

  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively.
  • A structured, precise and adaptable working style.
  • Strong communication and teamwork skills.
  • A positive attitude and ability to manage a dynamic work environment.
  • A high level of professionalism and work ethic.

We Offer

  • A full-time, two-year Researcher position. Salary according to the applicable salary scale and qualifications. Researcher salary range to be confirmed by HR but will be within 600 000 - 650 000 kr per annum.
  • Research collaboration with Dr Roufaida Laidi (PI), Prof. Ilangko Balasingham and Dr Hemin Ali Qadir, and with Prof. Tarik Taleb (Ruhr University Bochum).
  • A clinical research environment at The Intervention Centre, Oslo University Hospital.
  • Access to high-performance computing infrastructure at OUS and national e-infrastructure services.
  • An inclusive, interdisciplinary research environment at the Intervention Centre, OUS.
  • Pension, insurance and welfare schemes through the Norwegian public sector.
  • Family-friendly surroundings with cultural and outdoor opportunities in Oslo.

Your application

  • Submit a cover letter of at most one page explaining your interest in SYNAPSE and your fit with the position. Identify:
  • Your computer-networking background, naming relevant coursework, a thesis, substantial projects or publications and explaining your own contribution.
  • Your experience implementing machine-learning methods and using network simulation, emulation or testbeds.
  • The research area or areas above that best match your background and interests.

Supporting documents

  • A CV with a list of publications
  • Transcripts for your bachelor’s, master’s and PhD degrees, with the grading scale or diploma supplement.
  • Copies of your diplomas.
  • Up to three relevant publications. Briefly explain their relevance to the position and your contribution in the cover letter.
  • Names and contact details of two referees, at least one academic. Referees must not be family members.
  • Documents not in English or a Scandinavian language must be accompanied by a certified translation. Applications without transcripts and diplomas will not be assessed.

Submit your application electronically through Webcruiter.

KontaktinformasjonDr, Roufaida Laidi, Project leader, PI, roufaida.laidi@ous-hf.no Prof. Ilangko Balasingham, Section leader, ilangko.balasingham@ous-research.no ArbeidsstedSognsvannsveien 20 0372 Oslo Nøkkelinformasjon:Arbeidsgiver: Oslo universitetssykehus HF Referansenr.: 5200529751 Stillingsprosent: 100% Engasjement Startdato: 01.01.2027 Sluttdato: 31.12.2028 Søknadsfrist: 22.11.2026

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Sammen med pasienten utvikler vi morgendagens behandling Oslo universitetssykehus med våre 25 000 medarbeidere skal være en lærende og skapende organisasjon med evne til å tenke nytt. Vi skal ha en ledende rolle i utvikling av forskning og innovasjon, samt utvikling av morgendagens helsetjeneste, medisinsk behandling og presisjonsmedisin. Hos oss finner du noen av landets ledende eksperter innen sine fagfelt, og her blir du en del av Norges største helsefaglige arbeidsplass. As part of the VARD value chain, we work closely with shipowners, designers, and shipyards to create functional, sustainable, and high-quality onboard environments. With a strong focus on innovation, craftsmanship, and customer value, we help bring some of the industry’s most advanced vessels to life.

We are currently looking for a Supervisor Piping to join our team. In this role, you will have the opportunity to apply your expertise, collaborate with skilled colleagues, and contribute to exciting projects across the VARD value chain.

Ready to make an impact at VARD?

As part of our team, you'll benefit from:

title: Sales Representative (UK Market)
description:
We’re looking for a Partner Manager (B2B Sales) to help us grow in the UK market! If you’re a native or near-native (C2) English speaker with a passion for sales and the drive to build strong partnerships, keep reading!

 

About Nettbureau

Nettbureau is a Norwegian scale-up that helps consumers across Europe make better decisions through comparison and tender services like eiendomsmegler.no, flytta.se, luz.es, and fotovoltaico.it. Today, we operate 100+ services across 15 countries.

We combine strong growth with profitability and were recently named one of the Financial Times’ Europe’s Long-Term Growth Champions 2025. In Norway, we've been named a “Gaselle” company (one of the country’s fastest-growing businesses) for ten consecutive years, earning us a spot in the Hall of Fame.

We’re a team of 95+ people, with around 50 based in Oslo. You’ll join the UK team while also being part of a larger, international sales team working across multiple markets.

We value a friendly and flexible work environment, with opportunities to connect through both social activities and professional development.

📖 Learn more about us at Nettbureau.com and check out our employee handbook.

 

About the UK team

We launched in the UK in 2025, starting in the green energy space with sites such as solarenergy.co.uk and evchargers.uk. We’re a small, entrepreneurial team.

The team consists today of three people: a Content & Marketing Specialist, a Partner Manager, and a Country Manager. As our team grows, you’ll join as our second Partner Manager, working alongside our existing Partner Manager to grow our partner base.

You will work in a fast-moving environment where new services and verticals are continuously launched, giving you strong exposure and the opportunity to shape how we grow the UK market.

 

About the Role

As our new Partner Manager (B2B Sales), you will play a key role in launching and growing our UK market by acquiring new B2B customers and building long-term commercial partnerships.

While we generate a steady flow of high-quality inbound leads through our services, this is primarily a new business role. Your success will depend on consistently driving outbound prospecting, building your own pipeline, and actively creating new sales opportunities. Alongside winning new business, you’ll manage your own portfolio of signed partners: keeping them active and satisfied, growing their accounts, and making sure invoices are paid.

Our offering gives potential clients access to warm, relevant, GDPR-compliant leads with no upfront commitment. This creates a strong foundation for meaningful sales conversations and long-term client relationships.

You will work with a wide range of clients, from small local businesses to large multinational companies, across multiple industries and product verticals. This variety means high pace, constant learning, and significant ownership of your results.

 

Key responsibilities:

  • Own the full B2B sales cycle from prospecting to closing new business

  • Build and grow a strong pipeline through active outbound prospecting by phone and email, and follow up open prospects until they sign or decline

  • Deliver online presentations and product demos to prospective clients

  • Identify client needs and tailor solutions to match their business goals

  • Grow existing client accounts by finding ways to increase their value, such as more lead volume, new regions or additional services

  • Keep partners active and prevent churn by following up regularly and acting early on signs of dissatisfaction or reduced activity

  • Follow up on overdue invoices and work with our business operations and finance teams on cases that need escalation

  • Track and manage all sales activity in Pipedrive, our CRM system

  • Collaborate with internal teams (content, marketing and business operations) on partner feedback, lead delivery, sales processes and conversion rates

  • Contribute to the launch and scaling of new services in the UK market, by spotting new opportunities and helping ensure continued product-market fit

 

What We’re Looking For

We’re looking for a driven and proactive sales professional who enjoys building pipeline, winning new business, and taking ownership of their results.

You should be comfortable working in a high-activity environment where consistent prospecting and outreach are key to success.

You’ll likely thrive in this role if you have:

  • Native-level or C2 proficiency in British English, including the tone and conventions of UK business, with strong communication and negotiation skills

  • A proven track record of selling to UK businesses, with a good understanding of the UK business landscape

  • Documented experience in outbound B2B sales, i.e. finding and signing new clients

  • Experience working in a high-activity sales environment with clear targets

  • A proven ability to close sales remotely via phone, video calls, and email (this role is about selling remotely rather than face-to-face)

  • Strong ability to identify client needs and translate them into relevant solutions

  • Commercial understanding: the ability to assess the economics of a deal and prioritise the most valuable clients and profitable agreements

  • A disciplined and structured approach to managing your pipeline and sales process

  • Experience using CRM systems to track performance and prioritise effectively

  • Curiosity, adaptability, and motivation to continuously improve

No formal degree is required. We value proven sales skills and results over academic background.

Extra points if you have:

  • B2B sales experience in one of our verticals, such as renewable energy, real estate or telecommunications

  • Experience with performance-based or lead generation products

  • Familiarity with AI tools, sales automation or CRM automations to improve efficiency

  • A degree in business, marketing, sales or a related field

 

What We Offer

  • NOK 10,000/year for professional development

  • Flexible working hours at our Tøyen office in Oslo

  • Choice of Mac or PC, plus your mobile phone and home broadband paid for

  • Regular workshops with partners like Google, Meta, and Microsoft

  • A supportive and social work environment with ambitious colleagues

  • A subsidised canteen with healthy lunch options

  • Social events throughout the year, including after-work drinks, team activities, and an annual company trip

 

Excited about this role?

We’d love to hear from you. Please apply via our career portal with your CV and cover letter.

Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis.

  • Application deadline: 8 November 2026

  • Employment type: Full-time

  • Work location: Oslo, Norway (Hybrid)

  • Start date: As soon as possible

 

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Nettbureau builds online platforms that help people and businesses. For over a decade, we’ve connected users with great deals and suppliers with new customers in over 10 countries through lead generation. Our goal is to give users great deals to compare so they can make informed choices, while helping our suppliers to attract new customers. With recognition by the Financial Times in their list of “Europe’s Long-term Growth Champions” for 2025 and 2026, we’re focusing on sustainability and constantly improving every aspect of our services for our users, businesses and our team. Every year, we connect millions of users with our partners through bespoke technology designed to benefit both parties. Almost everything we do is built in-house, and we invest heavily in technology. We're a technology company, after all.

title: PhD Candidate in Resilient Service Continuity Across Mobile Networks
description:
This is NTNU

NTNU is a broad-based university with a technical-scientific profile and a focus in professional education. The university is located in three cities with headquarters in Trondheim.

At NTNU, 9,000 employees and 43,000 students work to create knowledge for a better world.

You will find more information about working at NTNU and the application process here.

   

Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_KHQjc4ndas&t=41sAbout the position

Are you motivated to pursue a doctoral degree and explore how mobile networks can work together to keep critical services running when facing failures or congestion?

The Department of Information Security and Communication Technology (IIK) at NTNU has a vacancy for a PhD Candidate in Resilient Service Continuity Across Mobile Networks. As a PhD Candidate with us, you will work to achieve your doctorate, and at the same time gain valuable experience that qualifies you for a range of leading positions in business, administration, higher education and research.

The position is fully funded and will run for 4 years (100 % employment), including teaching duties. Your immediate leader will be the Head of Discipline, and the workplace will be in Trondheim.

About the project

Mobile networks increasingly support critical services in emergency response, industry, transport, and maritime operations. Access to several networks can improve resilience, but sustaining a service requires more than restoring connectivity. Independently operated networks must coordinate resources and priorities while managing dependencies and commitments to existing users. They may also depend on shared infrastructure or capacity leased from one another, limiting the resilience gained from access to multiple operators. Norway’s plans for a new emergency network (Nødnett) over commercial mobile infrastructure illustrate the relevance of these broader challenges.

As a PhD candidate, you will investigate how mobile networks can cooperate to maintain critical services during failures, congestion, and recovery. Your research will address networks that retain their own operational policies and exchange limited information about capacity and internal state, developing insights applicable across public and private networks. A specific focus will be on the networked systems mechanisms, data paths, and open interfaces needed to support resilient service continuity in multi-operator mobile network systems, addressing research questions such as:

  • What information must networks exchange to make effective admission and resource-allocation decisions without requiring full visibility into each other’s infrastructure?
  • How can service priorities and resource policies be coordinated across heterogeneous networks, including during congestion and large bursts of registration requests?
  • How can network selection, traffic steering, and recovery mechanisms maintain application continuity while avoiding repeated switching and overload cascades?
  • How do shared infrastructure, leased capacity, and dependencies between operators affect failure propagation and the resilience gained from alternative network access?

With the Beyond 5G lab at the department, the project will emphasize experimental systems research: you will have the opportunity to conduct your research in both commercial and open-source mobile network deployments and test your ideas under realistic conditions. To explore conditions beyond the scale of the physical deployments, methods including simulation and analytical modeling can be a complementary building block.

Duties of the position
  • Complete doctoral education and obtain a doctorate
  • Carry out research of good quality within the framework described above
  • Academic publications and popular science dissemination
  • Participate in the Networking research group
  • Participate in international activities such as conferences and/or research stays at foreign educational institutions
  • Teaching in courses related to networking
  • Other career-enhancing work

Some changes to your work duties may occur after employment.

Required selection criteria
  • You must meet the requirements for admission to the faculty's Doctoral Programme in Information Security and Communication Technology, see Section 6-1 of the PhD regulations for more information.
    • You must have a relevant master's degree in communication networks, wireless and mobile communications, information security and distributed systems, or equivalent. Your degree must include a major independent project (minimum 30 ECTS) equivalent to a master’s thesis.
    • Master students can apply, but the master's degree must be obtained and documented before starting the position and preferably within August 2027.
    • You must have a strong and relevant academic background from your previous studies and have an average grade from your master's degree study, or equivalent education, which is equal to B or better compared to NTNU's grading scale. If you do not have letter grades from previous studies, you must have an equally good academic foundation. If you have a weaker academic background, you may be considered if you can document that you are exceptionally suited for a PhD education, for example through relevant work experience and/or peer-reviewed academic works.
    • If you are in your master’s program, integrated PhD could be an option. Your MSc grades after your fourth year need to be completed with a grade B or better, in addition the IE-faculty require that your bachelor degree is completed with a grade C or better. Integrated PhD - Faculty of Information Technology and Electrical Engineering - NTNU.
  • Excellent oral and written presentation skills in English.

The appointment is to be made in accordance with NTNUs guidelines for recruitment positions for general criteria for the position.

Preferred selection criteria
  • Practical experience with 5G radio access and core deployments.
  • Hands-on experience with communication networks including multi-vendor and softwarized environments.
  • Exposure to resilience and dependability topics in the context of communication networks as part of the master’s curriculum.
  • Teaching experience, preferably at master’s level.
  • Good oral and written presentation skills in Norwegian or another Scandinavian language.
Personal characteristics

To complete a doctoral degree (PhD), it is important that you are

  • Highly motivated by fundamental scientific research with practical relevance.
  • Able to work independently.
  • Able to work in a structured way, set goals, and make plans to achieve them.
  • Eager to disseminate research results both locally as well as through publications and presentations at international conferences.

In the evaluation of which candidate is best qualified, emphasis will be placed on education, experience and personal suitability, as well as motivation, in terms of the qualifications specified in the advertisement.

We offer
  • An exciting job with an important mission in society
  • Developing tasks in a strong and international professional environment
  • Career guidance and follow-up during the PhD period
  • Open and inclusive working environment with committed colleagues
  • Favorable terms as a member of the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund (SPK) 
  • Free Norwegian language training at a basic level (A2)

As a PhD Candidate at NTNU, you will have access to employee benefits.

Diversity

Diversity is a strength, and at NTNU we aim to be an employer that reflects the diversity in society and that makes use of the potential of the population's collective skills. Our vision is Knowledge for a better world and our values ​​are creative, critical, constructive and respectful. We believe that an organization that is equal, diverse, and gender-balanced is essential for us to achieve our goals. 

We strive to attract employees with different skills, life experiences and perspectives to contribute to even better problem solving of our societal mission in research and education. 

If you think this position is relevant and interesting, we encourage you to apply, regardless of gender, functional ability, and cultural background, or whether you have been out of work for a period of time.

At NTNU we want to increase the proportion of women in scientific positions. We have a number of measures to promote equality.

Salary and conditions

In the position of PhD Candidate code 1017, your gross salary will normally be NOK 580 000,- per annum depending on qualifications and seniority. A 2% statutory contribution to the State Pension Fund is deducted from the salary. 

The employment period is 3 years for the doctoral work in addition to one year of career promotion work.

The successful candidate will be granted conditional admission to the relevant doctoral programme when employed in the PhD position. It is a prerequisite for continued employment that the requirements for full admission are met within three months, and that you continue to participate in the organized doctoral programme for the remainder of the employment period. For more information about the requirements for full admission, please see Section 6 of the PhD regulations. 

As an employee at NTNU, it is important that you keep yourself up to date with academic and organizational changes and adapt to them.

For the necessary professional and social interaction, it is a prerequisite that you are physically present and available to the institution on a daily basis.

The appointment is carried out in accordance with the principles of the State Employees Act, and Export control (legislation that regulates the export of knowledge, technology and services). Candidates who, after assessment of the application and attachments, are considered to be in conflict with the criteria in the latter act, will not be able to be employed.

About the application

The application and all required attachments must be sent electronically via Jobbnorge.no before the deadline. The documents must be in Norwegian, another Scandinavian language or English. 

Please note: the application will only be assessed on the basis of the information we have received by the application deadline. Therefore, make sure that your application clearly shows how your skills and experience meet the criteria described above. If you are invited for an interview, you must present certified copies of certificates and diplomas upon request.

The application must include:

  • Transcripts and diplomas for bachelor's and master's degrees, including diploma supplement
  • CV filled out in Jobbnorge
  • Copy of master's thesis. If you have recently submitted your master's thesis, you can attach a draft of the thesis. Documentation of a completed master's degree must be presented before taking up the position.
  • A scientific proposal (max. 1000 words / 3 pages, written in English) including a brief problem formulation, research questions, methodological approach, and an initial progress plan for the project.
  • Short letter of motivation (max. 400 words / 1 page)
  • Any publications or other relevant research work
  • Any relevant certificates
  • Names and contact information of three relevant referees

If all, or parts of, your education has been taken abroad, we also ask you to attach documentation of the scope and quality of your entire education, both bachelor's and master's education, in addition to other higher education. If your institution does not offer “diploma supplement”, you must attach information about the grading scale from the education institution. 

We further recommend that you enclose a statement about your education abroad from the Norwegian Directorate for Higher Education and Skills (HK-dir). Follow the link to their web site for more information about how to obtain such a statement: Apply for recognition of foreign higher education. See also NTNU’s web site for documentation requirements for education obtained outside Norway. 

When assessing the best qualified, we emphasize necessary qualifications such as education, experience and personal suitability. Motivation for the position, ambitions, and potential for research will also count when assessing the candidates.NTNU recognizes a wide range of academic contributions and has committed itself to The San Francisco Declaration on Research Assessment and CoARA (responsible assessment of research and recognition of a greater breadth of academic contributions in accordance with NTNU's social mission).

General information

A public list of applicants with name, age, job title and municipality of residence is prepared after the application deadline. If you wish to be exempt from entry on the public applicant list, this must be justified. Assessment will be made in accordance with current legislation. You will be notified if the exemption is not granted.If you have any questions about the position, please contact Associate Professor Stanislav Lange, e-mail: stanislav.lange@ntnu.no. 

If you have any questions about the recruitment process, please contact Senior Executive Officer HR Julie Lindland e-mail: julie.lindland@ntnu.no. 

Application deadline: 30.11.2026.

For practical information about working at NTNU, please visit this webpage. 

The city of Trondheim is a modern European city with a rich cultural scene. Trondheim is the tech capital of Norway with a population of 200,000. The Norwegian welfare state, including healthcare, schools, kindergartens and overall equality, is probably the best of its kind in the world. Professional subsidized day-care for children is easily available. Furthermore, Trondheim offers great opportunities for education (including international schools) and possibilities to enjoy nature, culture and family life and has low crime rates and clean air quality. 

Om arbeidsgiveren:

NTNU - knowledge for a better world

The Norwegian University of Science and Technology (NTNU) creates knowledge for a better world and solutions that can change everyday life.

Department of Information Security and Communication Technology

Research is vital to the security of our society. We teach and conduct research in cyber security, information security, communications networks and networked services. Our areas of expertise include biometrics, cyber defence, cryptography, digital forensics, security in e-health and welfare technology, intelligent transportation systems and malware. The Department of Information Security and Communication Technology is one of seven departments in the Faculty of Information Technology and Electrical Engineering .

title: Upper School Counsellor - Starting Academic Year 2027
description:
The International School of Bergen is seeking an experienced, compassionate, and highly skilled School Counsellor to join our vibrant IB World School in Norway.

Hva vi ser etter

Application

We welcome applications from suitably qualified and experienced counsellors who are genuinely committed to relocating to Norway and becoming part of our school community.

Please submit the following documents by email with the subject line "US School Counsellor Application" to laura.mcguffie@isbergen.no:

  • A current CV.

  • A covering letter explaining your relevant counseling experience, qualifications, experience working with children and young people, and motivation for working at the International School of Bergen.

  • Contact details for two professional referees, including your current or most recent employer.

Important - Relocation to Norway

Please only apply if you are seriously considering relocating to Bergen, Norway.

Candidates who are currently living outside Norway should be prepared to relocate and meet the relevant Norwegian immigration, visa and work permit requirements, where applicable.

As part of the application process, candidates may be asked to provide information regarding their nationality/passport country and current country of residence so that the school can establish the appropriate immigration and work permit requirements.

This is an on-site based position in Bergen, Norway.

Safeguarding

The International School of Bergen is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and young people.

All appointments must provide a police background check from your home country and any country you have resided in for 6+ months in the last 10 years. Police background checks must be no more than 3 months old and can be presented prior to appointment.

All staff are expected to uphold the school's safeguarding policies and Code of Conduct.

Previous applicants should reapply if you are still seriously interested in the position.

If you have any questions in regards to this position, please contact Peter Ledger, Director peter.ledger@isbergen.no or Laura McGuffie, HR and Finance Manager laura.mcguffie@isbergen.no

Applications will be reviewed as they are received. We reserve the right to close this vacancy early if a suitable candidate is identified, so early applications are encouraged.

Closing Date for applications is 27th November 2026

Arbeidsoppgaver

About the Role

The School Counsellor will provide proactive and responsive counselling services to students across the school while supporting the implementation of a whole-school wellbeing programme consistent with the philosophy of the International Baccalaureate.

The role includes:

  • Providing confidential individual and small-group counselling.

  • Supporting students with social, emotional, behavioural and mental health needs.

  • Delivering preventative wellbeing programmes and age-appropriate classroom guidance.

  • Promoting resilience, self-management, positive relationships and emotional wellbeing.

  • Working collaboratively with teachers to identify and support students requiring additional care.

  • Advising school leadership on student wellbeing, safeguarding and pastoral care.

  • Liaising effectively with parents and guardians to support student success.

  • Coordinating referrals to external professionals and Norwegian support services where appropriate.

  • Supporting crisis response and student reintegration following significant life events.

  • Maintaining accurate, confidential records in accordance with GDPR and Norwegian legislation.

  • Contributing to safeguarding procedures and child protection practices.

  • Supporting transitions between PYP and MYP where applicable), ensuring continuity of care.

  • Promoting inclusion, diversity, intercultural understanding and student voice.

The Successful Candidate Will Have

Essential

  • A recognised qualification in Counselling, School Psychology, Educational Psychology, Social Work or a related field.

  • Professional registration or eligibility for registration where applicable.

  • Experience working with children and adolescents in a school setting.

  • Strong understanding of child and adolescent development.

  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills.

  • Demonstrated ability to build trusting relationships with students, families and staff.

  • Commitment to safeguarding and child protection.

  • High levels of professionalism, integrity and confidentiality.

  • Excellent spoken and written English.

  • A genuine willingness and ability to relocate to Bergen, Norway.

Desirable

  • Previous experience within an IB World School.

  • Knowledge of the IB Learner Profile and IB Approaches to Learning (ATL).

  • Experience supporting internationally mobile or multilingual students.

  • Experience working within multicultural communities.

  • Knowledge of trauma-informed and restorative practices.

Personal Attributes

We are looking for someone who is:

  • Compassionate and approachable.

  • Calm and solution-focused.

  • Collaborative and reflective.

  • Culturally responsive and internationally minded.

  • An excellent listener with sound professional judgement.

  • Passionate about student wellbeing and inclusion.

  • Committed to continuous professional learning.

  • Open to embracing life and work within an international school community in Norway.

Vi tilbyr

Why Join Us?

Our school offers:

  • A welcoming and diverse international community.

  • Students representing many nationalities and cultures.

  • A collaborative and supportive staff culture.

  • Commitment to ongoing professional development.

  • Competitive salary and pension.

  • The opportunity to live and work in one of the world's most beautiful and family-friendly countries.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

About Our School

ISB is a co-educational private day school which is authorised to deliver the International Baccalaureate PYP and MYP programmes. The school currently has approximately 250 students enrolled from more than 30 nations and is experiencing expanding enrolment. Classes are small with a maximum of 20 students in each instructional group.

Our school is committed to developing internationally minded young people who embody the attributes of the IB Learner Profile. We believe that student wellbeing is fundamental to learning, and we are looking for a counsellor who shares our commitment to nurturing the academic, social, emotional and personal development of every learner.

Working collaboratively with students, families, teachers and school leaders, the successful candidate will play a central role in promoting wellbeing, inclusion, safeguarding and positive mental health across the school community.

title: Senior Scientist within Applied Nuclear Technology
description:
The Institute of Energy Technology (IFE) is an independent research foundation in Norway, with locations in Kjeller and Halden. We are an internationally leading research environment that actively develops innovative solutions through people and technology. We operate under the mission 'Research for a better future'. IFE is a broad interdisciplinary research organization with top-level international expertise in digital technologies, material and process technology, flow and analysis technology, environmental technology, critical raw materials, radiopharmaceutical technology, and nuclear technology and safety.

The Tracer Technology Department at IFE is an internationally recognized research department with a strong and growing focus on applied nuclear technology. For more than 40 years, the department has pioneered tracer technologies and tracing methods used globally to study fluid flow, mass transport, and complex industrial and environmental processes. Today, we have extended our R&D competence and know-how on: tracers for Oil & Gas Industry, tracers for geothermal applications, environmental monitoring, critical raw materials and applied nuclear technology. We conduct research and innovation spanning within radiochemistry, medical radionuclides, neutron technologies, radiation-based industrial services, environmental radioactivity, advanced radioanalytical methods and process analytical chemistry. We are a core member of the Norwegian Nuclear Research Centre (NNRC), and we are hosting a national infrastructure project on neutron generators (HUNT).

A major strategic investment is IFE's future laboratory building, which is planned to house a whole floor of dedicated radioactivity laboratories designed to support advanced research, technology development, testing, and commercial services involving radionuclides, radioactive materials and irradiation. The department has responsibility for the on-going development, and use of IFE’s future radioactivity laboratories when these will be completed. They will comprise of state-of-the-art B-laboratories, neutron generator laboratories, irradiation facilities, a laboratory for processing of radioactive industrial sources, calibration of radiation measuring instruments and has access to extensive radioanalytical laboratories. By combining expertise in nuclear science, radiochemistry, analytical chemistry, and engineering disciplines, the department develops innovative research-based solutions and commercial services that contribute to technological advancement, industrial competitiveness, and the green transition. These facilities will provide a unique national capability for applied nuclear technology research and innovation, enabling us to translate scientific advances into practical solutions for the industry, the public authorities and international partners and customers.

Main responsibilities and work tasksWe are looking for a motivated and business-oriented senior researcher with expertise in Applied Nuclear Technology, with emphasis on irradiation technologies, neutron-based systems, radiation effects, and industrial applications of ionizing radiation.The successful candidate will generate and lead new research initiatives, secure funding from national, international, and industrial sources, and develop commercially relevant services based on irradiation technologies and radiation science. The role includes working with neutron generators, irradiation facilities, and other advanced radiation-based technologies, while collaborating closely with industrial customers to transform scientific advances into practical and valuable applications. You are strongly expected to develop and further expand the capabilities of the new radioactivity laboratories, and maximize the commercial and R&D potential of these facilities on national and international level.Educational Background

PhD (or equivalent experience) in Nuclear Engineering, Applied Nuclear Physics, Radiation Science, Experimental Nuclear Physics or a related field with preferably 5-10 years relevant experience after the completion of the Ph.D.Technical qualificationsDemonstrated experience in neutron generators and accelerator-based neutron sources is desired and in addition in one or more of the following areas:

  •  Gamma irradiation facilities
  •  Radiation effects testing of materials and electronic
  •  Radiation detection and measurement systems
  •  Nuclear instrumentation
  •  Neutron imaging and non-destructive testing
  •  Industrial applications of ionizing radiation
  •  Radioisotope production or radiochemical applications

Project generation qualifications

  •  Demonstrated track record of generating externally funded R&D projects from national, European, or industrial funding sources.
  •  Experience developing commercial research-based services and engaging with industrial partners.

Further experience

  •  Project leading experience is necessary.
  •  Experimentalist, with hands-on laboratory work experience.
  •  Contribution to development of regulatory documents for internal use or for the authorities regarding the instruments or the facility is expected.
  •  Strong awareness towards Health Safety Environment and Radiation Protection regulations compliance. The latter is highly important.
  •  Knowledge of nuclear instrumentation is an advantage but not required.
  •  Excellent communication in oral/written English. Norwegian language skills both oral and written or the genuine interest to learn within two years.
Personality

We are looking for a person who is a genuine team player, who creates safe and trust-based relationships both within our organization and with our customers.

  • Motivated and engaging person within the professional area and towards the colleagues.
  •  Proactive with high degree of initiative and creativity.
  •  Safe, clear and transparent communicator.
  •  You can lead project teams while also be a team-member.
  •  You should be solution-oriented.
  •  Structured.
  •  You take responsibility.
  •  You take decisions in line with the department and the organization.
  •  You enjoy cooperating with both academic and industrial partners.
We offer
  •  Competitive salary, pension- and insurance schemes.
  •  Exciting and challenging tasks in a team that works in the forefront of research.
  •  Participation in a leading international research team.
  • Collaboration with other departments.
  •  Competent and easy to collaborate colleagues in a professional environment that values mutual growth.
  •  A growing and healthy organization that is focused on individual and group development.
  •  Flexible working hours.

 

How to ApplyThe following application materials must be submitted through the IFE job application portal:

  • Cover Letter
  •  Curriculum Vitae
  •  Diplomas
We place great emphasis on your personal suitability for the position. IFE is subject to the Security Act, which includes requirements for the organisation’s management of critical national information, as well as other relevant legislation concerning the management of sensitive information. The successful applicant for the position advertised will have access to classified information and critical national objects and infrastructure. In order to meet the qualification criteria, the applicant must therefore meet the security clearance and/or authorisation requirements. Note that relevant applicants will be asked questions that are necessary to ascertain this. This includes questions about any ties to countries that the PST has classified as a ‘high-risk country’ in its open threat assessment. Background checks are performed as part of our recruitment process.ContactsGeorgios Kalantzopoulos, Department Head Christian Dye, Research Director, 415 11 823 LocationInstituttveien 18 2007 Kjeller Key information:Employer: Institutt for energiteknikk (IFE) Reference number: 5188929381 Percentage of full-time: 100% Permanent position Application deadline: 07/11/2026

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Research for a better future IFE conducts research for a better future. Since 1948, we have been a frontrunner in international energy research. We contribute to new solutions in renewable energy, petroleum and industry. We develop zero-emission transport solutions, digital systems and ground-breaking cancer medicine. IFE develops new solutions for the industry and public sector in over 30 countries. IFE is host to the international OECD NEA Halden Projects. We are about 550 employees and the annual turnover is about NOK 1,2 billion. Read more about IFE at www.ife.no/en

title: PhD Research Fellow in AI Native Networking for Healthcare
description:
We seek a PhD Research Fellow for a 3-year position in the SYNAPSE project. The successful candidate will have a solid background in computer networking and an interest in developing machine-learning methods for network control and network-aware distributed learning.

Section for Medical Information and Communication Technology (Medical ICT Research), The Intervention Centre (see: http://www.ivs.no), at Oslo University Hospital offers a full-time PhD Fellowship. The recruited PhD Fellow will be part of the Wireless Sensor Network Research Group of Professor Ilangko Balasingham and will be enrolled in the PhD program at the University of Oslo

We seek candidates with a solid background in computer networking who want to develop machine-learning methods for network control and network-aware distributed learning.

Oslo University Hospital is a workplace with great diversity. We believe this is crucial for solving our tasks in the best possible way. We want this diversity to be reflected among the applicants for our positions, and we encourage all qualified candidates, regardless of background, to apply!

Arbeidsoppgaver

About SYNAPSE

SYNAPSE, funded by the Research Council of Norway, develops networks that adapt their decisions to network conditions and the clinical urgency of the information they carry. Learning is integrated into network control to support decisions about scheduling, routing and resource allocation. For example, an urgent clinical alert should reach its destination promptly even when links are congested and patients are moving.

The project also develops distributed and federated learning methods that adapt to connectivity, available resources and clinical priorities. Network control and distributed learning are designed together, so that the network supports learning and learning remains effective when communication is constrained. The methods are evaluated in remote patient monitoring and hospital-at-home scenarios.

This position focuses on network protocols and their control at the MAC, network, transport and cross-layer levels, combined with machine learning. It does not cover hardware, antennas, circuits or physical-layer signal processing, and is not a general data-science position. Applicants must document relevant computer-networking knowledge and experience.

Research areas

  • Learning-based network control, including scheduling, link selection, routing and resource allocation in wireless and edge networks.
  • Reinforcement learning and multi-agent reinforcement learning for distributed network decision-making.
  • Graph and hypergraph representation learning of network state, including temporal graph neural networks.
  • Network- and urgency-aware distributed and federated learning, adapting the exchange of data and model updates to network conditions and clinical priorities.
  • Evaluation through network simulation and emulation, and with real remote patient monitoring data.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and evaluate learning-based methods for urgency-aware network control and network-aware distributed learning.
  • Implement and test the methods using network simulation or emulation and real monitoring data.
  • Publish in leading networking and machine-learning venues and complete a PhD at the University of Oslo, Faculty of Medicine.
Kvalifikasjoner (overskrift)

Required qualifications

  • A master’s degree (120 ECTS), including a thesis, in computer science, network or communication engineering, electrical engineering or equivalent.
  • A relevant bachelor’s degree (180 ECTS), with a total of five years of higher education.
  • A solid foundation in computer networking, demonstrated through relevant coursework and a substantial project, thesis or research experience involving network protocols, wireless or mobile networks, routing or network performance.
  • Coursework or project experience in machine learning, and good programming skills in Python.
  • A weighted average grade of B or better on the master’s degree, as required by the University of Oslo.
  • A master’s thesis graded B or better (Norwegian grading scale or equivalent).

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience with reinforcement learning or graph neural networks.
  • Experience with network simulation or emulation tools, such as ns-3, OMNeT++ or Mininet.
  • Publications or a master’s thesis combining networking and machine learning.

Language Requirements Applicants who are not proficient in a Scandinavian language must document English proficiency through one of the following: TOEFL: at least 600 (paper-based) or 92 (internet-based); IELTS Academic: at least 6.5, with no section below 5.5; Cambridge CAE/CPE: grade A or B.

Personal Qualities

  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively.
  • A structured, precise and adaptable working style.
  • Strong communication and teamwork skills.
  • A positive attitude and ability to manage a dynamic work environment.
  • A high level of professionalism and work ethic.

We offer

  • A fully funded, full-time three-year PhD position. Salary according to the Norwegian state salary scale (approximately NOK 550,800–587,000 per year).
  • Supervision by Dr Roufaida Laidi (PI), Prof. Ilangko Balasingham and Dr Hemin Ali Qadir, in collaboration with Prof. Tarik Taleb (Ruhr University Bochum).
  • A clinical research environment at The Intervention Centre, Oslo University Hospital.
  • Access to high-performance computing infrastructure at OUS and national e-infrastructure services.
  • An inclusive, interdisciplinary research environment at the Intervention Centre, OUS.
  • Pension, insurance and welfare schemes through the Norwegian public sector.
  • Family-friendly surroundings with cultural and outdoor opportunities in Oslo.

Your application

  • Submit a cover letter of at most one page explaining your interest in SYNAPSE and your fit with the position.

Identify:

  • Your computer-networking background, naming relevant coursework, a thesis, substantial projects or publications and explaining your own contribution.
  • Your experience implementing machine-learning methods and using network simulation, emulation or testbeds.
  • The research area or areas above that best match your background and interests.

Supporting documents

  • A CV.
  • Transcripts for your bachelor’s and master’s degrees, with the grading scale or diploma supplement.
  • Copies of your diplomas.
  • Documented English proficiency.
  • Names and contact details of two referees, at least one academic. Referees must not be family members.
  • Documents not in English or a Scandinavian language must be accompanied by a certified translation. Applications without transcripts and diplomas will not be assessed.

Submit your application electronically through Webcruiter

KontaktinformasjonDr. Roufaida Laidi, Project leader, PI, roufaida.laidi@ous-hf.no Prof. Ilangko Balasingham, Section leader, ilangko.balasingham@ous-research.no ArbeidsstedSognsvannsveien 20 0372 Oslo Nøkkelinformasjon:Arbeidsgiver: Oslo universitetssykehus HF Referansenr.: 5199969633 Stillingsprosent: 100% Engasjement Startdato: 01.01.2027 Sluttdato: 31.12.2029 Søknadsfrist: 15.11.2026

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Oslo University Hospital is a highly specialised hospital in charge of extensive regional and local hospital assignments and the provision of high quality services for the citizens of Oslo. The hospital also has a nationwide responsibility for a number of national and multi-regional assignments and has several national centres of competence. The hospital is Scandinavia's largest and we each year carry out more than 1.2 million patient treatments. Oslo University Hospital is responsible for approximately 50 percent of all medical and healthcare research conducted at Norwegian hospitals and is a significant role player within the education of a large variety of health care personnel. We are an emergency hospital for East and Southern Norway and have national emergency assignments. The hospital has a total budget of NOK 17 billion. More than 20,000 employees are engaged with activities at more than 40 different locations.

 

The University of Oslo is Norway's oldest and highest rated institution of research and education with 28 000 students and 7000 employees. Its broad range of academic disciplines and internationally esteemed research communities make UiO an important contributor to society. The Faculty of Medicine was established in 1814 and is the oldest medical faculty in Norway. The Faculty is organized into three basic units and has approximately 1,500 employees and about 2000 students. The Institute of Clinical Medicine (Klinmed) is one of three institutes under the Faculty. Klinmed is responsible for the Faculty's educational and research activities at Oslo University Hospital and Akershus University Hospital. With about 800 employees spread over approximately 425 man-labour years, Klinmed is the university's largest institute.

title: Ph.D. Candidate in Reinforcement Learning for Project Scheduling Problems
description:
This is NTNU

NTNU is a broad-based university with a technical-scientific profile and a focus in professional education. The university is located in three cities with headquarters in Trondheim.

At NTNU, 9,000 employees and 43,000 students work to create knowledge for a better world.

You will find more information about working at NTNU and the application process here.

   

Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_KHQjc4ndas&t=41sAbout the position

Are you motivated to take a step towards a doctorate and open up exciting career opportunities? As a PhD Candidate with us, you will work to achieve your doctorate, and at the same time gain valuable experience that qualifies you for a further career in higher education and research, in and outside academia.

The position will specifically focus on Reinforcement Learning for Resource-Constrained Project Scheduling Problem (RCPSP). The Ph.D. candidate will be a member of the group of Civil Engineering and Geomatics at NTNU and will tightly cooperate with other Ph.D./post-docs in projects (such as HEU-CIRCULess) and research groups at the department. The Ph.D. position will offer opportunities to develop high-quality research within the field of digitalization of circular construction.

Your immediate leader will be the Head of Department.

Duties of the position

 

  • Develop learning-based algorithms or methods for deterministic scheduling optimization problems with the aim of achieving competitive performance against state-of-the-art approaches. 
  • Extend the developed framework to scheduling under uncertainty. Investigate how the proposed learning-based methods can be extended to uncertain and dynamic project environments.
  • Improve the scalability of learning-based scheduling methods and evaluate generalization, robustness, and computational performance.
  • Disseminate research outcomes. Publications in relevant high quality peer-reviewed journals  are needed. 
  • Complete the doctoral education until obtaining a doctorate
  • Carry out research of good quality within the framework described above
  • Academic publications and popular science dissemination
  • Participate in the research group  Civil Engineering and Geomatics Research group Civil Engineering and Geomatics - NTNU

Be prepared for changes to your work duties after employment.

Required selection criteria
  • You must have a relevant master’s degree in Computer Science and technology, computer system engineering or equivalent. Your course of study must correspond to a five-year Norwegian course, where 120 credits have been obtained at master's level. 
  • Experience in reinforcement learning, GNN, etc.
  • You must have a strong academic background from your previous studies and have an average grade from your Master's degree study, or equivalent education, which is equal to B or better compared to NTNU's grading scale. If you do not have letter grades from previous studies, you must have an equally good academic foundation. If you have a weaker grade background, you may be considered if you can document that you are particularly suitable for a PhD education.
  • You must meet the requirements for admission to the faculty's Doctoral Programme https://www.ntnu.edu/studies/phiv
  • Applicants must have fluent skills in both written and oral English. Non-English native speaker applicants who do not have master in Europe must provide evidence of good English language skills, written and spoken. The following tests can be used as such documentation: TOEFL, IELTS or Cambridge Certificate in Advanced English (CAE) or Cambridge Certificate of Proficiency in English (CPE). Minimum scores are: TOEFL: 600 (paper-based test), 92 (Internet-based test); IELTS: 6.5, with no section lower than 5.5 (only Academic IELTS test accepted); CAE/CPE: grade B or A.
  •  In extraordinary circumstances, formal documentation of language skills can be relinquished. In such cases, the candidate’s language skills will be assessed in a personal interview.

 

PLEASE NOTE: For detailed information about what the application must contain, see paragraph “About the application”.

 

The appointment is to be made in accordance with NTNUs guidelines for recruitment positions for general criteria for the position.

Preferred selection criteria
  • Academic publication in relevant field. 
  • Experience in programming skills, and artificial intelligence.
Personal characteristics

To complete a doctoral degree (PhD), it is important that you are able to: 

  • Work independently
  • The applicant must be motivated to work closely with teams and external partners 
  • Work constructively under pressure or in the face of adversity 
  • Show curiosity and strong motivation for the subject

Emphasis will be placed on personal qualities.

We offer
  • An exciting job with an important mission in society
  • Developing tasks in a strong and international professional environment
  • Career guidance and follow-up during the PhD period
  • Open and inclusive working environment with committed colleagues
  • Working capital that can be used to implement the project
  • Mentor programme as a new employee at NTNU
  • Favorable terms as a member of the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund (SPK)
  • Free Norwegian language training at a basic level (A2)

As a PhD Candidate at NTNU, you will have access to employee benefits.

Diversity

Diversity is a strength, and at NTNU we aim to be an employer that reflects the diversity in society and that makes use of the potential of the population's collective skills. Our vision is Knowledge for a better world and our values ​​are creative, critical, constructive and respectful. We believe that an organization that is equal, diverse and gender-balanced is essential for us to achieve our goals. 

We strive to attract employees with different skills, life experiences and perspectives to contribute to even better problem solving of our societal mission in research and education. 

If you think this position is relevant and interesting, we encourage you to apply, regardless of gender, functional ability and cultural background, or whether you have been out of work for a period of time.

At NTNU we want to increase the proportion of women in scientific positions. We have a number of measures to promote equality. 

Salary and conditions

In the position of PhD Candidate, code 1017, your gross salary will normally be NOK 580 000,-per annum depending on qualifications and seniority. A 2% statutory contribution to the State Pension Fund is deducted from the salary. 

The employment period is 3 years for the doctoral work.

For employment as a PhD Candidate, it is a prerequisite that you gain admission to the PhD programme in Engineering https://www.ntnu.edu/studies/phiv within three months of your employment contract start date, and that you participate in an organized doctoral programme throughout the period of employment.

As an employee at NTNU, it is important that you keep yourself up to date with academic and organizational changes and adapt to them.

For the necessary professional and social interaction, it is a prerequisite that you are physically present and available to the institution on a daily basis.

The appointment is carried out in accordance with the principles of the State Employees Act, and Export control (legislation that regulates the export of knowledge, technology and services). Candidates who, after assessment of the application and attachments, are considered to bein conflict with the criteria in the latter act, will not be able to be employed.

About the application

The attachments (including a description of your scientific work) must accompany the application as these documents form the basis of the application assessment. The documents must be in English.

Please note: the application will only be assessed on the basis of the information we have received by the application deadline. Therefore, make sure that your application clearly shows how your skills and experience meet the criteria described above. The application and all attachments must be sent electronically via Jobbnorge.no. If you are invited to an interview, you must bring certified copies of certificates and diplomas upon request.

The application must include:

  • Transcripts for Bachelor's and Master's degrees
  • Diplomas for Bachelor's and Master's degrees
  • Copy of Master's thesis
  • Project outline containing proposals for an overall description of research questions, theoretical perspectives, methodological design for the project and progress plan (maximum 1500 words/4 pages) 
  • Short letter of motivation (400 words/1 page)
  • Possibly publications etc. other relevant research work
  • Possibly certificates
  • CV
  • Names and contact information of three relevant referees

If all, or parts, of your education has been taken abroad, we also ask you to attach documentation of the scope and quality of your entire education, both Bachelor's and Master's education, in addition to other higher education. If your institution uses “diploma supplement” (normal for most European institutions), you must attach this. A description of the documentation required can also be found here. If you already have a statement from Norwegian Directorate for Higher Education and Skills (HK-dir), please attach this as well.

Joint work will be considered. If it is difficult to identify your contribution to joint work, you must attach a brief description of your participation.

When assessing the best qualified, we emphasize necessary qualifications such as education, experience and personal suitability. Motivation for the position, ambitions, and potential for research will also count when assessing the candidates.NTNU recognizes a wide range of academic contributions and has committed itself to The San Francisco Declaration on Research Assessment and CoARA (responsible assessment of research and recognition of a greater breadth of academic contributions in accordance with NTNU's social mission).

General information

A public list of applicants with name, age, job title and municipality of residence is prepared after the application deadline. If you wish to be exempt from entry on the public applicant list, this must be justified. Assessment will be made in accordance with current legislation. You will be notified if the exemption is not granted.

If you think this position looks interesting and in line with your qualifications, you are welcome to apply.

If you have any questions about the position, please contact Yongping Liu (Associated professor), email yongping.liu@ntnu.no. 

If you have any questions about the recruitment process, please contact HR Advisor Kristine Rognlid Hagaseth, e-mail: kristine.r.hagaseth@ntnu.no.

Application deadline: 16.11.2026

title: For client we ar looking for Training Coordinator/Admin Support
description:
Training Coordinator & Administrative Support 

 

Are you an organized, detail-oriented professional who thrives on keeping complex processes running smoothly?

 

For client we are looking for a Training Coordinator to join a global organization operating within the medical devices certification industry, covering a parental leave for a one-year period.

 

 Our client is a globally recognized provider of inspection, certification, and testing services, known for its high professional standards, sustainable approach, and strong commitment to employee development. As an accredited certification body within the medical devices sector, the team plays a key role in ensuring products and systems meet international safety and quality regulations.

 

About the role

 

This is a developing role, meaning it is not fully fixed in scope - there is room for you to bring your own input and help shape how it evolves. As Training Coordinator, you will act as the key link between assessors/auditors, external training providers, and local market units, working closely with the medical devices competence team. alongside the coordination responsibilities, you will also take on a range of administrative support tasks, including simpler ad-hoc duties.Your responsibilities will include:

  • Ensuring courses are carried out as planned, including logging and follow-up
  • Providing support and arranging meetings
  • Uploading online training courses and updating related materials
  • Maintaining an up-to-date catalogue of available courses within the medical devices business
  • Coordinating timely scheduling and completion of course amendments
  • Maintaining the Training Matrix alongside the Competence Matrix
  • Ensuring all training certificates are properly issued
  • Registration of projects and certificates
  • Preparing reports and data analysis using Power BI
  • Handling registrations in the MDSAP database
  • Managing legalization of certificates
  • Supporting certification management, including cancellations and handling of invalid/false certificates

We are looking for someone who:

  • Has a keen eye for detail and works with accuracy
  • Is efficient and structured in their approach
  • Is comfortable managing multiple administrative processes in parallel, proactively
  • Can work independently
  • Has experience with training coordination, certification administration, or similar support functions

  • Thrives in a collaborative, international environment with close cross-functional cooperation

This is a great opportunity to gain insight into a highly regulated, international industry and build valuable experience in training coordination and certification administration within the medical devices field.

Start date: October 2026Location: Alvdal, NorwayAccommodation: Available initially for NOK 3,500 per month

title: Technical Co-Founder / CTO
description:
Technical Co-Founder / CTO — CreativeWork

Oslo, Norway | Equity-based | Full-time commitment expected in 2027

About CreativeWork

CreativeWork is an early-stage technology startup founded in Oslo, building a digital ecosystem for the creative industry

We're making it easier for creative professionals to offer their services, connect with clients, manage bookings, collaborate, deliver work, and get paid securely — all through one platform.

We've started with photography and videography in Norway, but our ambition is international. Over time, we plan to expand into other creative disciplines and introduce collaboration tools, studio and equipment rentals, and resources that help independent creatives grow their businesses.

CreativeWork is already live!

We're a registered Norwegian company with a launched platform, early users, and a growing product foundation.

We've already developed:

  • Creator profiles, portfolios, and customizable service packages.

  • Search, booking requests, messaging, and notifications.

  • Stripe Connect integration for secure payments and payouts.

  • Structured cancellation, refund, and booking workflows.

  • Delivery confirmation, automated completion, reviews, and dispute resolution.

  • Administrative and platform management tools.

We're now focusing on growth, product improvements, and preparing for our next stage.

The Opportunity

We're looking for a Technical Co-Founder / CTO who wants to take ownership of the technology and help build CreativeWork into an international company.

This isn't a traditional developer position. We're looking for an entrepreneurial partner who can shape the product, make technical decisions, and help build a scalable business.

You'll be responsible for:

  • Leading technical architecture, development, and infrastructure.

  • Taking ownership of the existing application and codebase.

  • Ensuring security, reliability, performance, and scalability.

  • Developing new features and improving existing workflows.

  • Defining engineering processes and eventually building a technical team.

  • Participating in product strategy, fundraising, and accelerator programs.

Who We're Looking For

Ideally, you have:

  • A degree in computer science, software engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

  • Strong full-stack development experience, particularly backend engineering and architecture.

  • Experience with React, TypeScript, Node.js, databases, and modern web technologies.

  • Experience building and maintaining real production applications.

  • Knowledge of cloud infrastructure, APIs, security, and integrations.

  • Strong problem-solving skills, initiative, and a sense of ownership.

Experience with startups, marketplaces, payment systems, or technical leadership is a major advantage, but not a requirement.

Most importantly, you're someone who wants to build a company, not simply work on another project.

About the Founder

I'm a product and service designer with around 10 years of experience in digital innovation, complex services, and product development.

My background includes working with organizations such as DNB, Sopra Steria, and other companies across the Norwegian technology and design industry.

I hold a master's degree in Design from the Oslo School of Architecture and Design (AHO).

I'll lead product vision, UX, business development, customer research, and partnerships, while we share responsibility for the company's strategy and growth.

What We Offer

  • Meaningful co-founder equity, negotiated based on commitment, responsibilities, and existing contributions.

  • An existing company, launched platform, and early user base — not just an idea.

  • Real ownership of the technology, engineering strategy, and future technical team.

  • Flexible initial involvement, with availability for full-time commitment during 2027 expected.

  • Participation in incubators, accelerators, funding opportunities, and potential international expansion.

We're actively exploring accelerator programs and funding opportunities in Norway and internationally, with the ambition of scaling beyond the Norwegian market.

CreativeWork is currently pre-revenue, and a fixed salary is not guaranteed at this stage. Compensation and ownership will be discussed transparently.

Let's Build Something Together

We're looking for someone with technical expertise, entrepreneurial ambition, and the motivation to build something meaningful over the long term.

If you've considered becoming a startup founder and want to join a company with an existing product, a clear vision, and international ambitions, we'd love to hear from you.

Feel free to reach out, learn more about what we're building, or apply directly through The Hub.

CreativeWork AS — Born in Oslo 🇳🇴

  • Website: https://creativework.app

  • Instagram: @creativework.app

  • LinkedIn: CreativeWork

  • Founder: Amir Arsalan Shamsabadi

Where Creativity Connects.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

CreativeWork is a Norwegian technology startup building a digital marketplace for the creative industry, making it easier and safer for people to discover, hire and collaborate with creative professionals. Today, finding and working with photographers, filmmakers and other creative talents is often fragmented across social media, personal networks and disconnected tools. Customers struggle to find trusted professionals, compare services and manage bookings, while creators face challenges attracting clients, coordinating projects and securing payments. CreativeWork brings the entire process into one platform: professional profiles, portfolios, service discovery, booking, communication, agreements, secure payments, delivery and reviews. Our first version is already launched in Norway, initially focusing on photography.

title: Bemanningskoordinator / Helsefagarbeider
description:
Trives i en varierende og spennende arbeidshverdag? Og ønsker du å få brukt din kompetanse i ulike fagmiljø og være en bidragsyter til god tjenesteutvikling? Da er du kanskje helsefagarbeideren vi søker.

Bemanningsenheten skal formidle og tilby kvalifisert, serviceinnstilt og fleksibelt personell til kommunens avdelinger med turnusdrift i Helse og mestring. Vi skal nå utvide med flere ansatte, og har ledig 100% fast stilling som bemanningskoordinator, med arbeid på dag/kveld og helg. Det vil bli en kombinasjon mellom kontor og ute i pleien. 

Vi har forventninger til faglig utvikling og et godt arbeidsmiljø. Som bemanningskoordinator har du mulighet til å arbeide i 1-2 ulike avdelinger, i tillegg til å være på kontoret. Du vil både bli en del av et team på 8 personer, og øvrige ansatte i enheten.

Du vil få god opplæring i oppgavene både inne på kontoret og ute i avdelingene. Da stillingen ikke er på den samme avdelingen over lengre tid, vil du normalt ikke ha primærkontaktansvar. 

Vi setter tilstedeværelse og fleksibilitet høyt. Medarbeidere i bemanningsenheten trives i møte med nye mennesker, både kolleger og pasienter/ brukere. Her vil du  inkluderes i et engasjerende og faglig dyktig team med gode kolleger som støtter hverandre. Dette er en spennende avdeling med høyt tempo, hvor vi gjør hverandre gode.

Ta gjerne kontakt for en utfyllende prat om du har spørsmål. Alle bes fylle ut cv, samt legge ved vitnemål og attester når de søker. Referanser må oppgis i en ev. videre ansettelsesprosess. Politiattest må legges frem ved ansettelse. 

Arbeidsoppgaver
  • Bistå avdelingene med å dekke fravær herunder planlegge og skaffe vikarer med rett kompetanse.
  • Bindeledd mellom avdelingene og vikarene
  • Faglige oppgaver ut fra behov.
  • Din kompetanse vil bli benyttet på de aktuelle avdelingene.
  • Kartlegge pleiebehov, prioritere og iverksette tiltak.
  • Bidra til gjennomføring av gode pasientforløp, samarbeide tverrfaglig med interne og eksterne aktører( tjenestekontoret, sykehuset, ergo, fysio, pårørende).
  • Dokumentere i kommunene dokumentasjonssystem (Gerica).
Kvalifikasjoner
  • Autorisasjon som helsefagarbeider / helsefaglig bakgrunn
  • Arbeidserfaring fra fagområdet
  • Kunnskap om lov- og avtaleverket knyttet til arbeidsbestemmelsene
  • Gode IKT-ferdigheter
  • Økonomiforståelse
  • Førerkort klasse B
  • Du må kunne kommunisere godt på norsk, både muntlig og skriftlig, minimum nivå B1
  • Det er en fordel med kunnskap og erfaring fra arbeid med turnus og bemanning
  • Det er en fordel med kjennskap til Visma
Personlige egenskaper
